summary: We've developed a browser-access game, about managing a Marsian outpost. The application is designed for young students between ages 7 to 12. Our game encourages young astronauts to learn responsible decision-making and face consequences. The game features accessible mechanics, where every click has outcomes. players have to adapt their strategy and future playthroughs. Ultimately the mission is successful or failed, providing students a learning curve. Project S.O.L. Trainer can be further expanded. The finished product would be offered to local schools.
details: Our web application has a simple designed interface, with many mechanics. The player's goal is to fill up the research bar, while managing needs, like meals, oxygen and power.
